$comment: PROPOSAL for Idris (CTO), not yet a ruling. The licence allowlist stackra/verify's licence-policy step enforces over every package the Quality Gate installs (`pnpm licenses list --json --offline --recursive`, STA-2761). `allow` holds SPDX ids; an expression passes when every AND part and at least one OR part is allowed. Measured on main 79f0ba8e (box 1, full install, 2026-11-24): MIT 1423, Apache-2.0 154, ISC 116, BSD-3-Clause 33, BSD-2-Clause 17, BlueOak-1.0.0 15, MPL-2.0 8, Unlicense 4, CC0-1.0 3, MIT-0 2, 0BSD 2, Python-2.0 1, CC-BY-4.0 1, CC-BY-3.0 1, Zlib (inside an AND) 1. Beyond the five permissive core licences, each extra id and each exception below needs the CTO's yes. An exception holds for one package under the exact licence string it names; a change of licence fails the step again. Read by tools/scripts/stackra-verify.mjs; the verify service takes main's copy of this file (VERIFY_OVERLAY).
